description: This file defines HTTP handlers and server setup for a health check API, including endpoints to report application status and listen for status changes via channels.

methods.name: writeJsonResponse
methods.description: Serializes an entity to JSON and writes it to the HTTP response.

methods.name: handleHealth
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the /health endpoint, returning application and job status.

methods.name: listenForStatusChanges
methods.description: Listens on a channel for status messages and updates global status variables accordingly.

methods.name: StartHTTP
methods.description: Initializes start time, launches status listener, and starts HTTP server on specified port.
